dedupe_keys.name: road accidents in india 2023 ministry of road transport and highways transport research wing

description: Road Accidents in India 2023 is the annual report of the Transport Research Wing of India's Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH). It records 4,80,583 road accidents in 2023 that claimed 1,72,890 lives. Data come from the police departments of states and union territories, collected by calendar year in standardised formats from UNESCAP's Asia Pacific Road Accident Data (APRAD) project. Coverage: all states and union territories; tables split accidents, deaths and injuries by road category (national highways, state highways, other roads), by state, by type of traffic rule violation, for million-plus cities, and state performance against earlier years, with series from 2019 or 2020 to 2023. Format and access: a PDF report with charts and tables, free to download from the MoRTH site. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated. Caveats: tables are in PDF, so they need extraction before analysis; police-reported data under-count some injuries. The figures support road-safety baselines by road class and state and the calibration of crash risk in network resilience studies for India. It relates to the WHO road safety status report and the EU CARE database in the catalogue.
